pages.name: 1 bit in, 1px out · I · the mercury sphere
pages.blurb: A liquid-mercury sphere girdled by the 52-bubble packed line. The arc carries the bit along the line, the bubbles only attest, and the 1px lights at the end.

pages.name: 1 bit in, 1px out · II · the ledger says which
pages.blurb: All four runs his buttons offer, in turn: moniker 1 and 0, with and without the drop. A dark pixel is a delivered 0 or a loss, and the receipt beside the ledger says which.

pages.name: 1 bit in, 1px out · III · quicksilver thread
pages.blurb: The watermark thread runs under the line: the bit rides it, 1 bit at ~1.1502e-36 m, under the 1% cross-talk floor.

pages.name: 11 across, 2px out · I · twin threads
pages.blurb: Two threads ride under the line, one for each bit of the pair. Pair 11 in, 2px out.

pages.name: 11 across, 2px out · II · sixteen runs
pages.blurb: Sixteen quicksilver beads, one for each run his buttons offer: 4 pairs × 4 drops (off, A, B, both), all running at once.

pages.name: 11 across, 2px out · III · pair orbit
pages.blurb: The pair orbits a neon-lit quicksilver sphere, going through every pair and drop in turn.

pages.name: dog on a leash, cubits in tow · I · leash → end{}
pages.crumb: DOG ON A LEASH, CUBITS IN TOW · I
pages.blurb: The dog runs the line on its leash to end{}; both 1/2 cubits come in tow behind it, and the 2px light when the tow arrives.

pages.name: dog on a leash, cubits in tow · II · tow −4 bubbles
pages.crumb: DOG ON A LEASH, CUBITS IN TOW · II
pages.blurb: The tow starts 4 bubbles behind the dog and chases where the dog was 12 frames earlier. The I-13 VM works out the steady lag.

pages.name: dog on a leash, cubits in tow · III · end{} droplets
pages.crumb: DOG ON A LEASH, CUBITS IN TOW · III
pages.blurb: end{} as a gold ring among mercury droplets: the leash holds the dog there while the cubits catch up.

pages.name: The Living Kernel Dreams · I · the dreaming kernel
pages.blurb: A dreaming organic kernel sphere. Its 18 foam stars, moon, rune stones, embers and still lake all come from his kernel seed, re-dreamed every 14 s.

pages.name: The Living Kernel Dreams · II · foam, pops & wave
pages.blurb: A bioluminescent kernel. The foam cells, pops, wave and verdicts in his seed are checked against each other as his own system.

pages.name: The Living Kernel Dreams · III · the still lake
pages.blurb: A pearl-nacre kernel above the still lake: the held stillpoint ring of 18, the zero that doesn't move.

pages.name: Quicksilver & Kernel · Index
pages.blurb: Dave’s four quicksilver arc and Living Kernel pages, carried into 12 agentic, artistic sphere worlds. His originals are kept byte-identical and his mechanics are checked and run on Dave’s I-13 engine.
